(() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(String(v || '').replace(/&/g, '&'), location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-src','data-original','data-lazy-src','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } return ''; }; const idOf = (href) => { try { const u = new URL(href, location.href || base); return (u.pathname + u.search).replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; const out = []; const seen = {}; document.querySelectorAll('li.list-item.card').forEach((item) => { const link = item.querySelector('a.list-img[href*="/photo/"]') || item.querySelector('.list-body a[href*="/photo/"]'); if (!link) return; const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; const url = abs(href); if (!/\/photo\/\d+(?:_\d+)?\.html/i.test(url)) return; const id = idOf(url); if (!id || seen[id]) return; const img = item.querySelector('a.list-img img'); const cover = abs(attr(img)); if (!cover || /loading\.gif|gif\.php|url\.php|logo|qrcode/i.test(cover)) return; const titleEl = item.querySelector('.list-body a[href*="/photo/"]') || link; const title = clean(titleEl.textContent || (img ? img.getAttribute('alt') : '') || id); if (!title) return; const genre = Array.from(item.querySelectorAll('dl dd a')).map((a) => clean(a.textContent)).filter(Boolean).join(', '); const count = clean(item.querySelector('.list-num span')?.textContent || ''); seen[id] = true; out.push({ id, title, cover, url, status: 'completed', author: genre, genre, description: count }); }); return JSON.stringify(out); })();

actions.code: (() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; const page = Math.max(1, parseInt('{{page}}', 10) || 1); let category = String('{{category}}' || '').replace(/^\{\{[^}]+\}\}$/, '').trim().replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); if (!category) category = 'i'; if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(category)) return category; if (category.indexOf('tags/') === 0) return page <= 1 ? base + '/' + category + '/' : base + '/' + category + '/' + page + '.html'; return page <= 1 ? base + '/' + category + '/' : base + '/' + category + '/index_' + page + '.html'; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(String(v || '').replace(/&/g, '&'), location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-src','data-original','data-lazy-src','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } return ''; }; const idOf = (href) => { try { const u = new URL(href, location.href || base); return (u.pathname + u.search).replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; const out = []; const seen = {}; document.querySelectorAll('li.list-item.card').forEach((item) => { const link = item.querySelector('a.list-img[href*="/photo/"]') || item.querySelector('.list-body a[href*="/photo/"]'); if (!link) return; const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; const url = abs(href); if (!/\/photo\/\d+(?:_\d+)?\.html/i.test(url)) return; const id = idOf(url); if (!id || seen[id]) return; const img = item.querySelector('a.list-img img'); const cover = abs(attr(img)); if (!cover || /loading\.gif|gif\.php|url\.php|logo|qrcode/i.test(cover)) return; const titleEl = item.querySelector('.list-body a[href*="/photo/"]') || link; const title = clean(titleEl.textContent || (img ? img.getAttribute('alt') : '') || id); if (!title) return; const genre = Array.from(item.querySelectorAll('dl dd a')).map((a) => clean(a.textContent)).filter(Boolean).join(', '); const count = clean(item.querySelector('.list-num span')?.textContent || ''); seen[id] = true; out.push({ id, title, cover, url, status: 'completed', author: genre, genre, description: count }); }); return JSON.stringify(out); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^\{\{[^}]+\}\}$/.test(raw)) raw = ''; if (!raw && /\/photo\//i.test(location.href || '')) raw = location.href; if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw; return new URL(raw.replace(/^\/+/, ''), base.replace(/\/+$/, '/') + '/').href; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(String(v || '').replace(/&/g, '&'), location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const title = clean(document.querySelector('.album-top h1')?.textContent || document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || document.title).replace(/\s*-\s*美图乐.*$/i, ''); const meta = {}; const dts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.album-top dl dt')); dts.forEach((dt) => { const key = clean(dt.textContent); const dd = dt.nextElementSibling; if (key && dd) meta[key] = clean(dd.textContent); }); const tags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.album-top dl dd a')).map((a) => clean(a.textContent)).filter(Boolean); const img = document.querySelector('.content img'); const cover = img ? abs(img.getAttribute('src') || img.getAttribute('data-src') || '') : ''; const desc = clean(document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')?.getAttribute('content') || ''); const lines = ['拍摄机构: ' + (meta['拍摄机构'] || ''), '出镜模特: ' + (meta['出镜模特'] || ''), '发行日期: ' + (meta['发行日期'] || ''), '照片数量: ' + (meta['照片数量'] || '')].filter((line) => !/:\s*$/.test(line)); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author: meta['出镜模特'] || meta['拍摄机构'] || '', status: 'completed', description: [desc].concat(lines).filter(Boolean).join('\n'), genre: tags.join(', '), updateTime: meta['发行日期'] || '' }); })();

getChapterList.description: 按图片范围切分虚拟章节

actions.code: (() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw; return new URL(raw.replace(/^\/+/, ''), base.replace(/\/+$/, '/') + '/').href; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; const groupSize = 10; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const canonical = (() => { try { const u = new URL(location.href || base); u.hash = ''; return u.href; } catch (e) { return String(location.href || ''); } })(); const idBase = (() => { try { const u = new URL(canonical); return (u.pathname + u.search).replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return canonical.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } })(); let total = 1; const text = clean(document.body ? document.body.textContent : ''); const countMatch = text.match(/照片数量\s*[:：]?\s*(\d+)/) || text.match(/(\d+)\s*[张張枚]\s*(?:图片|照片|写真)?/); if (countMatch) total = Math.max(total, parseInt(countMatch[1], 10) || 1); document.querySelectorAll('ul.page a[href*="/photo/"]').forEach((a) => { const h = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; const m = h.match(/\/photo\/\d+_(\d+)\.html/i); if (m && !countMatch) total = Math.max(total, parseInt(m[1], 10) || 1); }); total = Math.min(Math.max(total, 1), 260); const out = []; for (let start = 1; start <= total; start += groupSize) { const end = Math.min(start + groupSize - 1, total); out.push({ id: idBase + '#mxrange=' + start + '-' + end, title: '第 ' + String(start).padStart(3, '0') + '-' + String(end).padStart(3, '0') + ' 张', url: canonical + '#mxrange=' + start + '-' + end, size: end - start + 1, date: '', publishTime: '' }); } return JSON.stringify(out.length > 0 ? out : [{ id: idBase + '#mxrange=1-10', title: '第 001-010 张', url: canonical + '#mxrange=1-10', size: 10, date: '', publishTime: '' }]); })();

getPageList.description: 按虚拟章节提取图片 URL

actions.code: (() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; let raw = String('{{chapterId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^\{\{[^}]+\}\}$/.test(raw)) raw = ''; if (!raw) raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^\{\{[^}]+\}\}$/.test(raw)) raw = ''; if (!raw && /\/photo\//i.test(location.href || '')) raw = location.href; let url = /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw) ? new URL(raw) : new URL(raw.replace(/^\/+/, ''), base.replace(/\/+$/, '/') + '/'); const range = (url.hash.match(/mxrange=(\d+)-(\d+)/i) || [])[0] || 'mxrange=1-10'; const start = parseInt((range.match(/mxrange=(\d+)-/i) || [])[1], 10) || 1; const m = url.pathname.match(/\/photo\/(\d+)(?:_\d+)?\.html/i); if (m) url.pathname = start <= 1 ? ('/photo/' + m[1] + '.html') : ('/photo/' + m[1] + '_' + start + '.html'); url.search = ''; url.hash = range; return url.href; })();

actions.description: 提取当前分段原图 URL

actions.code: (() => { const base = 'https://www.meitula.org'; const img = document.querySelector('.content img'); let imageUrl = img ? (img.getAttribute('src') || img.getAttribute('data-src') || '') : ''; try { imageUrl = new URL(imageUrl, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) {} return JSON.stringify({ imageUrl }); })();

changes: 将大图集拆分为每 10 张一个虚拟章节，大幅缩短阅读器首图等待时间
getPageList 改为只提取当前分段图片，后续分段由章节切换和现有预加载机制继续加载
根据真实站点批量请求耗时将阅读器分页等待窗口调整到 45 秒，避免慢网络下只返回部分图片
将阅读器分页图片提取改为后台批量请求，避免大图集逐页同步请求超过脚本执行窗口
为详情分页请求增加短间隔重试，降低偶发断连导致阅读器缺页或空列表的概率
修复大页数图集在阅读器 getPageList 中触发 JavaScript 8000ms 超时的问题
分页原图提取改为更轻量的 HTML 正则解析，并为长分页图集显式配置脚本超时
修复阅读器把分页 HTML 当图片加载导致 PixelMap 解码失败的问题
分页列表直接返回 .content img 的 JPG/WebP 原图直链，并保留 pageUrl 作为兜底解析入口
支持最新、周榜热门、POST 搜索、标签筛选、详情与逐页原图读取
